name: ​Kizirushi Ren
source:
A friendly young man who ran away from home due to his mother's excessive interferences in his life. However, after escaping, he was chosen to be the Natsume family's "god" and was imprisoned by them.

Because of his trauma, he prefers not to socialize and keeps a distance from others. He is very weak-willed.
